purpose: Test whether the classical PSD mixed-discriminant positivity criterion based only on subset ranks extends to the much narrower JANUS P0 principal-transversal carrier. It does not, even with one full unit of rank slack on every nonempty clause subset.

external_donor_boundary.psd_fact: For positive semidefinite matrices, positivity of the mixed discriminant admits a Hall/Konig-type characterization by rank inequalities rank(sum_{i in S} A_i)>=|S| for all index subsets S, leading to a matroid-intersection decision algorithm.
external_donor_boundary.warning: The present theorem does not dispute the PSD result. It proves only that P0 plus nonnegative 0/1 principal minors is insufficient to inherit that criterion.

unsat_proof: (x1 OR x2) and (x1 OR NOT x2) force x1=1.
Then (NOT x1 OR x3) forces x3=1.
Then (NOT x3 OR x4) and (NOT x3 OR NOT x4) force x4 and NOT x4 simultaneously.

p0_carrier.construction: Build the block-diagonal K from v2.8. Mixed degree-3 variables use K3=[[1,1,-1],[1,1,-1],[0,-1,1]], mixed degree-2 variables use K2=[[1,1],[1,1]]. Let D_C be the diagonal projector onto occurrences in clause C and A_C=K D_C.
properties: Every principal minor of K is 0 or 1.
The target coefficient W(F)=[product_C z_C] det(I+sum_C z_C A_C) equals zero because F is UNSAT.

exact_rank_census.statement: For every nonempty clause subset S, rank_Q(sum_{C in S} A_C)>=|S|+1.
exact_rank_census.stronger_than_naive_hall: The ordinary condition rank(sum_{C in S} A_C)>=|S| not only holds; every nonempty subset has at least one extra rank.

theorem.name: P0_HALL_RANK_INEQUALITIES_DO_NOT_CERTIFY_TARGET_COEFFICIENT_POSITIVITY
theorem.statement: There exists a bounded-occurrence 2/3-CNF P0 principal-transversal instance for which every nonempty subset-rank inequality rank(sum_{C in S} A_C)>=|S|+1 holds, yet the full-clause coefficient W(F) is zero.
proof: The frozen formula is UNSAT by the direct implication proof above, so v2.8 gives W(F)=0.
The checker constructs K and every A_C exactly over Q and exhausts all 31 nonempty clause subsets.
The exact census gives the displayed minimum ranks 2,3,4,5,6 for subset sizes 1,2,3,4,5, respectively.
Hence all Hall-style rank inequalities hold with unit slack despite coefficient zero.

killed: Extending the PSD mixed-discriminant positivity theorem to the v2.8 P0 carrier by replacing PSD with 'all principal minors nonnegative'.
Any decision rule that depends only on the rank function S -> rank(sum_{C in S} A_C) and accepts whenever all Hall inequalities hold.
not_killed: A criterion using oriented/sign data beyond ranks.
A Pfaffian/determinantal cancellation identity specialized to the local K2/K3 blocks.
A nonlinear augmentation theorem on clause transversals.

next_target.name: E8_ORIENTED_RANK3_P0_TRANSVERSAL_INVARIANT_V3_0
next_target.directive: Any successful polynomial criterion must retain more than subset ranks. Search for an oriented-minor/Pfaffian invariant, exact exchange obstruction, or source-aligned cancellation rule that distinguishes the frozen UNSAT witness from SAT instances with the same rank profile without enumerating transversals.
